name: Allotment Society
blurb: Two hundred members, one shed, and a waiting list older than some of the councillors. They vote as a bloc and hold grudges as a bloc.

name: Hurst Estate Tenants
blurb: The lifts have been broken since the last election. Nobody on the estate has forgotten who promised to fix them.

name: Chapel Street Retirees
blurb: Remember Malcolm from his driving-instructor days. Some of them fondly. Several of them failed.
